about: The Korean and Unicode matrix's declared failures (docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-18-own-native-engine-design.md, Verification system part 6; scripts/native-matrix/unicode-plan.mjs). A row of the matrix's `unicode` section that is read back unequal to its expected text fails, unless a declaration here names that row's id (`<field>/<condition>[@<user>]/<method>.<string>`) and engine (vendor or cua) with its kind and its cause (autocorrection, an app that ignores Unicode events, a normalization the app applies). The expected text is the string sent, except pressKey's r k, which the active input method composes (ruling 1119, #189): rk under the Latin source, 가 under Korean 2-Set engaged, in every field; a pressKey row cannot be declared, so one that composes otherwise fails. The per-context rows are not judged (ruling 1119, #185) and need no declaration. A declaration excuses only a failed row; one no failed row needed is named in the run's meta and the summary. Empty until a run shows a failure with a named cause.
